│  - Memory decay over time                                  │
│  - Importance-based slot selection                         │
│  - Attention-based update mechanism                        │
│  - Adaptive learning rates per slot                        │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

KEY COMPONENTS:
- WorkingMemory: Persistent memory buffer with 3 update strategies
- SophisticatedAttention: Multi-head attention with rotary embeddings
- SwiGLU: Gated activation function for MLP
- System2Block: Combines all components with residual connections
- System2Module: Main module with multiple layers and reasoning history
